_comment: Example Music Limited -- standard per-site address allocation policy. Single source of truth for generate_inventory.py and bind9-dns.yml (Play 2, standard-slot DNS synthesis) -- keep these two consumers in sync by editing only this file, not either script.

_addressing..100-.249: DHCP  DHCP Pool (.101/.102 shown below are documentation examples within this pool, not exclusive reservations)
_addressing..82-.94: WAP   Wireless access points (static — added 2026-07-08, moved off DHCP). Count varies per site (1 to 13+); devices.csv rows at these octets are treated as standard-slot and excluded from the .ini/DNS output the same way BMC is — only the generic commented placeholder lines show, per-device Notes are not preserved for slots at this range.
